name: Bible Basics
description: A quiz for everyone — 21 questions on the most well-known people, stories, and facts from the Bible. No prior reading required.
author: Bible Millionaire Team

questions.text: Who built a large boat (ark) to survive a great flood?
In which city was Jesus born?
What is the very first book of the Bible?
Who was the first man God created, according to the Bible?
What did young David use to defeat the giant Goliath?
Who betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver?
How many disciples did Jesus choose?
What was the name of the first woman in the Bible?
In which garden did Adam and Eve live before the Fall?
Which prophet was swallowed by a large fish?
Which body of water did Moses part so the Israelites could cross on dry ground?
What were the Ten Commandments written on?
How many days and nights did it rain during Noah's flood?
Whose city walls fell after the Israelites marched around them?
Which disciple denied knowing Jesus three times before the rooster crowed?
Who was the earthly mother of Jesus?
How many books are in the Protestant Bible?
In which language was the New Testament originally written?
Which prophet was taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire?
What gift did the young King Solomon ask God to give him above all else?
What were the names of Noah's three sons?
